description.text:
Paris Baguette is the perfect destination when you’re craving a delightful treat (or several). Established in 1988, this globally renowned bakery chain has captivated guests for over three decades with its specialty cakes, each handmade and hand-finished in-store. Paris Baguette also offers an enticing selection of pastries, sandwiches, baguettes, salads, and tarts. What began as a small bakery has grown into a global favourite, celebrated for its artisanal breads and French-inspired bakery delights.

At Paris Baguette UK in Canary Wharf, you’ll experience a taste of Parisian elegance whether you’re in the mood for a light snack or a decadent slice of cake. Join us and indulge in the art of fine baking with every visit.
